study: Post-review joint aging and report-cost diagnostic
reservations: Twice development p95 of per-round average wall time, rounded upward to 0.05 ms; one reservation per method, fixed over rho and tau/T.
timing: One warmed thread, serial randomized method order; generation and execution checks excluded from online wall time.
statistics: Bonferroni simultaneous 95% paired t intervals across both IVP contrasts at all 30 cells and both cost modes (120 contrasts). Wilson risk intervals are pointwise; no reliability certification from finite counts.
scope: Known Gaussian initial/execution log gains at fixed N=4, UL-heavy load. rho is not converted to speed or a Doppler coherence time. Same sufficient-certificate allocator, not the stronger validated frontier. Endpoint execution, not time-integrated packets.
